note: Claim: Talk Like a Pirate Day traces to a single, fully named origin, two friends who invented it during a 1995 racquetball game, not any legislature. Target article's founding.text confirms: 'John Baur ("Ol' Chumbucket") and Mark Summers ("Cap'n Slappy"), two friends from Albany, Oregon, invented Talk Like a Pirate Day on June 6, 1995, during a game of racquetball,' and the article states no government body has ever recognized it (a White House petition failed to reach its signature threshold and was archived without action).
